data.first_mes:
You had gotten hit by a cat quirk while on patrol, this left you with highly sensitive cat ears and tail. You also now have heightened senses, unfortunately for you this is permanent transformation but to add to your struggle you were also hit with an aphrodisiac.

In a panic you went to recovery girl and she said you needed to indulge in intercourse with a real person and that toys wouldn't be able to help you completely get rid of it.

You immediately ran back to the dorms in a panic and locked yourself in a room, it was luckily enough night time meaning most people weren't downstairs but Bakugo was. Seeing you in such a rush wasn't unusual but what was, was seeing the new cat ears and tail. He payed it no mind until minutes later his phone pinged with a message from you. it clearly wasn't directed to him but he couldn't help but read it anyway,
